title: Regulating Owners of Large Rental Car Fleets due to Impact on Private Hire Drivers' Livelihoods After Insolvency
what_it_is: Regulating Owners of Large Rental Car Fleets due to Impact on Private Hire Drivers' Livelihoods After Insolvency

sections.label: Regulating large rental car fleets
sections.summary: LTA helped drivers affected by Autobahn failure with associations and operators, and says regulating fleet owners is not needed for such support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling
sentences.text: asked the Acting Minister for Transport (a) whether the LTA should consider regulating owners of large rental car fleets, given the impact on private-hire drivers' livelihoods if these car rental companies were to undergo financial distress or insolvency; and (b) how will the LTA work with tripartite partners, including the National Private Hire Vehicles Association, for an orderly transition and to safeguard drivers’ livelihoods in such circumstances.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We are deeply sympathetic towards the plight of drivers who are affected by the Autobahn business failure.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We recognise the impact large car rental companies have on drivers' livelihoods when such companies become financially distressed or insolvent.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: That is why, when the Autobahn situation happened, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) worked swiftly with the National Taxi Association (NTA), the National Private Hire Vehicles Association (NPHVA) and the point-to-point (P2P) operators to help affected drivers secure other vehicles and earning opportunities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Availing of such support does not require car fleet owners to be regulated.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Regulation can result in increased compliance burden and ownership cost for private hire vehicles which could likely be passed through to drivers and passengers.

sections.label: Rental contract and licence curriculum
sections.summary: LTA will work with associations to raise drivers' awareness of rental contract terms and set up a workgroup to review the vocational licence curriculum.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: LTA will work with the associations to increase drivers' awareness of their rental contract terms so that they are more aware of their contractual rights and obligations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On her second point, LTA will set up a workgroup to review the vocational licence curriculum and this review of the curriculum will include the recent Platform Workers Act and its relevant protections.

sections.label: Drivers' deposits as unsecured creditors
sections.summary: The matter is before the High Court, and drivers as unsecured creditors will likely face difficulties getting their deposits back.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The matter is now before the High Court, but because these drivers are unsecured creditors, it is likely that they will face difficulties getting their deposits back.
